term_glossary.plain_words: Copy one, not delayed, weight minus one.
Copy two, delayed by log 2, weight three.
Copy three, delayed by log 4, weight minus two.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: This is compactDifference (log 2) g in the source file. A delayed copy is zero before it starts: delay a g u = g(u - a) for u > a and 0 otherwise.
formulas.common_misreading: That the delayed copies are defined for all u by the same formula. They are zero-extended, which is what makes the one-sided Laplace rule exact.

term_glossary.plain_words: One pure tone of the curve.
The same tone, seen in the transform: a pole at rho.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: For Re s > Re rho the integral of e^{(rho - s)u} over u > 0 is 1/(s - rho). The right-hand side continues to all s != rho.
formulas.common_misreading: That a pole is a defect. It is the transform's record of one tone in the curve.

term_glossary.plain_words: The number q for this tone: a turn and a shrink.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: e^{rho(u - a)} = e^{-rho a} e^{rho u}, and e^{-rho log 2} = 2^{-rho}.
formulas.common_misreading: That a delayed spiral is a different spiral. It is the same spiral times one complex number.

term_glossary.plain_words: First arrow.
Second arrow.
Third arrow.
The gap that is left.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: The three weighted, delayed tones at one fixed u are the complex numbers -1, 3q, -2q^2 times the tone.
formulas.common_misreading: That weights summing to zero force the arrows to close. They close only when q = 1 (or q = 1/2).

term_glossary.plain_words: The one number the mix multiplies this tone by.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: A translation-invariant operation has the exponentials as eigenfunctions. Valid for u > log 4, after all three copies have started.
formulas.common_misreading: That the mix changes the shape of a tone. It changes only its size and phase.

term_glossary.plain_words: Copy one: no delay, weight minus one.
Copy two: the delay log 2 becomes the factor 2 to the minus s.
Copy three: the delay log 4 becomes 4 to the minus s.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: Laplace transform of the mix: each delay a contributes e^{-sa} (laplace_delay in the source), with a = 0, log 2, log 4.
formulas.common_misreading: That m depends on the curve g. It does not: it is the same function for every g.

term_glossary.plain_words: Zero only when q is 1.
Zero only when q is one half.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: Expand (1 - q)(2q - 1) = 2q - 1 - 2q^2 + q. This is `symbol` in the source file.
formulas.common_misreading: That a quadratic in q with real roots says nothing about complex s. It says everything, through q = 2^{-s}.

term_glossary.plain_words: The single variable of the mix.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: With c = log 2, e^{-sc} = 2^{-s} and e^{-2sc} = 4^{-s} = q^2.

term_glossary.plain_words: The distance of q from the origin.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: |e^{-s log 2}| = e^{-Re(s) log 2}: the imaginary part of s only turns q.
formulas.common_misreading: That the imaginary part of s changes the size of q.

term_glossary.plain_words: The inner circle: the kill point q = 1/2 is on it.
q, trapped strictly between.
The outer circle: the kill point q = 1 is on it.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: 2^{-sigma} is strictly decreasing, equal to 1 at sigma = 0 and to 1/2 at sigma = 1. This is the pair `upper`, `lower` in symbol_strip.
formulas.common_misreading: That the inequalities could be weak. They are strict, and strictness is the proof.

term_glossary.plain_words: The change of Im s that turns q once around.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: arg q = -Im(s) log 2, so q returns after Im s grows by 2 pi / log 2 = 9.0647.

term_glossary.plain_words: The least distance of q from the kill point 1.
Twice the least distance of q from the kill point 1/2.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: |1 - q| >= 1 - |q| and |2q - 1| >= 2|q| - 1, with |q| = 2^{-sigma}. Equality when q is real and positive, that is at Im s = 2 pi k / log 2.
formulas.common_misreading: That the landscape touches the floor in its valleys. The valleys are low (at most 1/8) and never zero.

term_glossary.plain_words: How much louder the first zeta zero's tone comes out.
The same pole, with residue m(rho) times r.

formulas.derivation_or_motivation: m(s) r/(s - rho) = m(rho) r/(s - rho) + r (m(s) - m(rho))/(s - rho), and the last quotient is analytic at rho (dslope in the source).
formulas.common_misreading: That multiplying by a function can move or split a pole. An analytic nonvanishing factor only rescales the residue.

color_identity.the kill points q = 1 and q = 1/2, the z: ember #e8623c (an added accent: the only things that can kill)
